verdict.rationale: Cekura ships its own Skills plugin and MCP server so AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot can design, run and improve voice-agent evaluations, and manage testing and observability through natural-language interaction. All of this is documented only in vendor docs, and it depends on an external AI assistant rather than a native natural-language interface. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documented depth of which operations the Skills/MCP cover, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Install Cekura Skills and MCP so your AI assistant can design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations.
Whether you're using Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code, you can manage your voice agent testing and observability directly from your development environment.
The plugin bundles Skills, slash commands, and MCP config in one install.
Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and other AI coding assistants.
